summary_1line: Yayati installs Puru as king, retires to the forest for severe austerities, reaches heaven, is cast down by Indra, and his later return to heaven is foreshadowed.

image_candidates.scene_text: The aged king Yayati places the crown upon his son Puru while gathered people and Brahmanas look on in approval.
Yayati stands on one leg amid four blazing fires under the scorching sun, performing severe austerities in the forest.
The celestial king Indra casts Yayati down from heaven, leaving him suspended in the vast sky between heaven and earth.
